benchmark.name: FrontierChallenge

summary.en: FrontierChallenge tests agents on end-to-end scientific-computing workflows that must deliver a complete, contract-checked artifact bundle.
summary.zh: FrontierChallenge 评估 agent 完成端到端科学计算工作流的能力，要求交付一套通过任务契约检查的完整产物。

task_format.en: The agent drives domain software such as ORCA, CP2K, LAMMPS or AmberTools to complete one of 97 released scientific tasks and deliver the required artifacts.
task_format.zh: agent 调用 ORCA、CP2K、LAMMPS、AmberTools 等领域软件，完成 97 个公开科学任务之一，并交付要求的产物。

explanation.en: A task passes only when its grader score reaches 99.9, i.e. the full task contract is met; the score is the fraction of the 97 released tasks passed.
explanation.zh: 只有当任务的 grader 分数达到 99.9、即完全满足任务契约时才算通过；分数是通过的任务占 97 个公开任务的比例。

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
